overview: This week: gravitational-wave workflows use CNNs and neural-guided Bayesian inference for LISA, EMRI, and Einstein Telescope; LLM pipelines extract dark-matter models and galaxy discussions, and FAIR Universe releases a weak-lensing uncertainty benchmark. Other work presents JAX Gaussian-process inference, an explainability library, 4MOST Cepheid abundance networks, and a learned Mars atmosphere model.
